sentences.text:
Amit Kumar Dohare vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12
December, 2024
Neutral Citation No. 2024:Mphc-Gwl:22112
 1 Mcrc-52130
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
At Gwalior
Before
Hon'Ble
Shri Justice Rajendra Kumar Vani

On The 12th Of December, 2024
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 52130 of 2024
 Amit Kumar Dohare
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
 Appearance:
 Shri Pradeep Katare - Advocate for the applicant.
Shri Abhishek Bhadoriya - Public Prosecutor for the State.

Order 
This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. /483 of BNSS for grant of bail relating to Crime No.127/2024 registered at Police Station, Daboh, District Bhind (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 363, 366(A), 376, 368, 34 of IPC and Sections 5/6 of the POCSO Act.
As per prosecution case, the applicant took away the prosecutrix, who is allegedly 13 years of age, by persuading her and committed rape with her.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the case.
He is in custody since 11.07.2024.

As per prosecution case, the present applicant has committed abduction and thereafter rape with the prosecutrix, who is said to have been 13 years old,
but actually the prosecutrix was above 18 years of age and at the time of her statement she was 19 years of age as admitted by her in court
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-GWL:22112 2 MCRC-52130-2024 statement as PW-2, copy of her court statement is appended at page No.11.
Though DNA report is positive, but that is also suspicious as only on Pubic hair DNA has been found, however, on clothes and in vaginal swab no DNA has been found.
Grand-father of the prosecutrix and prosecutrix herself have turned hostile and they did not support the story of prosecution at all.
There is no criminal antecedents against the applicant.
He is ready and willing to abide by all the terms and conditions which may be imposed by this Court.
Conclusion of trial will take time.
On these premises, learned counsel prays for bail.
Per contra, learned counsel for the State opposed the bail application and prayed for its rejection.

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.

Considering the submissions advanced by learned counsel for the parties and attending facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lac Only) with a solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/committal Court.
In case, if he is found involved in the offence of same nature, this bail order shall stand cancelled automatically without further reference to the Bench.

5) The applicant will not seek unnecessary adjournments during the trial;
6) The applicant will not leave India without previous permission of the trial Court/Investigating Officer, as the case may be.
Copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance.
Certified copy as per rules.

(RAJENDRA KUMAR VANI) JUDGE ms/-
